subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Bodhidharma's Eyelids
description: Learn Bodhidharma's Eyelids in one minute.

hook.text: A Buddhist legend says tea grew from the severed eyelids of Bodhidharma, the monk who brought Zen to China.

buildup.text: Bodhidharma vowed to meditate for nine years without sleeping. When his eyelids drooped, he cut them off in frustration.

discovery.text: Where his eyelids fell, tea bushes sprouted. The leaves carried his determination—keeping all who drink them awake.

twist.text: This legend is more popular in Japan than China. It connects tea directly to Zen discipline and spiritual endurance.

climax.text: The eyelid myth explains why tea and Zen monasteries are inseparable in East Asian culture. Tea sustains meditation.

punchline.text: Severed eyelids, sprouting bushes, endless wakefulness. Tea's darkest origin story.

quiz.question: According to the legend, why does tea keep people awake?
options: It came from a magical spring
It grew from Bodhidharma's severed eyelids, carrying his determination
